commits.author: Oliver Drotbohm
commits.message:
GH-1917 - Skip stale-publication handling for statuses without configured staleness.

DefaultEventPublicationRegistry now only marks publications as failed for statuses Staleness.isMonitored(…) reports as monitored, so configuring only the resubmitted timeout no longer fails PUBLISHED and PROCESSING publications. StalenessProperties rejects zero and negative durations and refuses staleness lookups for statuses that cannot become stale.

commits.author: Oliver Drotbohm
commits.message:
GH-1903 - Honor registry trigger annotation for publication completion.

CompletionRegisteringAdvisor used to decorate all AFTER_COMMIT @TransactionalEventListener methods, no matter whether spring.modulith.events.registry-trigger-annotation excluded them. For an excluded listener no publication is ever registered, so the completion fell back to the payload-based lookup in the repository, which serializes the event and thus failed for events that cannot be serialized.

The decision which event listener methods are considered by the Event Publication Registry is now encapsulated in EventListenerMethodMetadata, used by both the advisor and TransactionalEventListeners.

commits.author: cwjohnpark
commits.message:
GH-1901 - Use type name for array types in FormattableType.of(ResolvableType).

FormattableType.of(ResolvableType) used Class#getName(), which renders array types by their JVM binary names (e.g. [B or [Ljava.lang.String;). As the instance is cached under the same key that FormattableType.of(Class) uses, the broken instance also leaked into Class-based lookups, so the result depended on call order. We now use Class#getTypeName() in line with FormattableType.of(Class).

Original pull request: GH-1902

commits.message:
GH-1895 - Defer event mapping in Namastack outbox mode

Store the original domain event in the Namastack outbox and apply the configured mapping when the record is delivered. This keeps selection and routing based on the original event and reports mapping or broker serialization failures as outbox failures.

commits.author: Oliver Drotbohm
commits.message:
GH-1899 - Declare releaseTrain profile explicitly to deactivate profiles active by default.

Maven only deactivates profiles active by default if any of the explicitly activated profiles is declared in the same pom that declares the one active by default. We now explicitly declare the releaseTrain profile so that the one named "default" is properly disabled.

commits.author: Oliver Drotbohm
commits.message:
GH-1565 - Allow resubmission of publications with a null status.

The JPA, JDBC and Neo4j event publication repositories guarded status transitions (markProcessing(…), markFailed(…), markResubmitted(…)) with a "status != target" condition. NULL never compares equal or unequal to anything in SQL/Cypher, so publications whose status column was NULL (e.g. carried over from a schema predating that column, or written by another persistence layer) could never be resubmitted or marked failed again, without any error or log output.

Use TestContextAnnotationUtils.findMergedAnnotation() instead of
AnnotatedElementUtils.findMergedAnnotation() to resolve
@ApplicationModuleTest/@ModuleSlicing, so that annotations declared on
an enclosing class are found for @Nested test classes as well.
